predicted.title: Fountain
predicted.description: **Marcel Duchamp's** revolutionary **readymade** transformed a mass-produced urinal into one of modern art's most provocative gestures by simply signing it "R. Mutt" and submitting it to an exhibition. This audacious act challenged the very definition of art, asserting that the artist's choice—not craftsmanship or beauty—could elevate an everyday object to aesthetic status. Rejected by the 1917 Society of Independent Artists, **Fountain** became a cornerstone of **Dada's** anti-establishment philosophy and opened the floodgates for **Conceptual Art**. The work remains a lightning rod for debates about authorship, taste, and institutional power in the art world.

predicted.title: Sunburned GSP #858

predicted.title: Untitled (Hanging Wire Sculptures)

predicted.title: Calavera with Guitar
